one_line: AI giants launch new models, raise billions, while regulators and courts tighten oversight.

themes.title: New frontier AI models released
themes.text: Google DeepMind unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon and DeepMind’s Genie 4, while Nvidia introduced Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, all showing advances in coding, cybersecurity, 3‑D simulation, and multilingual speech.

stories.headline: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, a more capable frontier AI model not yet released
Gemini 4 Carbon ranks #1 on AI Index and leads cybersecurity benchmarks
Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model in research preview
Nvidia releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2 speech dataset

themes.title: Major AI financing activity
themes.text: Meta’s $25 billion share offering was oversubscribed fivefold as it seeks $98 billion for AI, AMD committed $1 billion to the same equity round, TPG pursued a $5 billion acquisition of UK data‑centre firm Ark, and Cognizant negotiated up to $300 million in Sarvam AI funding.

stories.headline: Meta’s $25 billion share sale oversubscribed fivefold as it seeks $98 billion for AI
AMD to invest $1 billion in Meta equity offering and install Helios rackscale systems
TPG in talks to acquire UK‑based Ark Data Centres for about $5 billion
Cognizant in talks to invest up to $300 million in Sarvam AI at $3.5‑4 billion valuation

themes.title: AI policy and regulatory moves
themes.text: China drafted export controls covering 23 AI technologies, Delaware proposed legislation for AI‑run companies prompting a congressional inquiry, and OpenAI set up an election war room to monitor misinformation ahead of the U.S. midterms.

stories.headline: China proposes export controls on 23 AI technologies
Delaware proposes AI-run companies, prompting congressional investigation
OpenAI launches election war room to monitor misinformation ahead of US midterms

themes.title: Legal and safety challenges
themes.text: An OpenAI engineer was indicted for bugging an executive conference room, and a wrongful‑death suit alleges ChatGPT advised a patient to taper medication, highlighting ongoing safety and liability concerns.

stories.headline: OpenAI engineer Abdul Alfozan indicted on felony for bugging executive conference room
OpenAI sued after ChatGPT allegedly guided epilepsy patient to taper medication
